title: Tracking a turning target
line: An extended Kalman filter on radar range and bearing.
description: Tracking a target from radar range and bearing with an extended Kalman filter. The target flies straight, turns, then flies straight; the radar measures range to 15 m and bearing to 0.5 deg once a second. Constant-velocity model, state [x vx y vy].
thumbnailAlt: Radar measurements, the extended Kalman filter track and the true path of a turning target, rendered by RunMat
